subject: Potential Bug in Modification Indices (in the current version, 0.5-18)

messages.author: 174d93c480fdfd8a
messages.subject: Potential Bug in Modification Indices (in the current version, 0.5-18)
parts:
In a model in which two groups are specified and some parameters are constrained to be equal across groups, modification indices behave differently in the new (0.5-18) and in the previous (0.5-17) versions of lavaan.
  • Version 0.5-17: the indices take the exact same value for the same parameters in group 1 and in group 2. Although I am not an expert, this makes a lot of sense to me.
  • Version 0.5-18: the values of the modification indices are different among groups.
Below you can find a toy example that shows the issue. Please try it with the latest version of lavaan and with the older version if you want to see it yourself.

I think that this might be a bug

######################################################################################################
# install version 0.5-17
install.packages("http://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/Archive/lavaan/lavaan_0.5-17.tar.gz", repo = NULL, type = "source")
# install latest version
#install.packages("lavaan")
library(lavaan)
library(MASS)

# simulate the data for two groups
set.seed(1)
cormat1 <- cormat2 <-  matrix(.4, nrow = 4, ncol = 4)
diag(cormat1) <- diag(cormat2) <- 1
cormat2[1,2] <- cormat2[2,1] <- .1 # introduce a clear difference among the groups
  
data1 <- mvrnorm(n = 100,
                 mu = c(1, 1, 1, 1),
                 Sigma = cormat1)
data2 <- mvrnorm(n = 100,
                 mu = c(1, 1, 1, 1),
                 Sigma = cormat2)
data <- data.frame(rbind(data1, data2))
data$group <- c(rep(1, 100), rep(2, 100))

# define a toy moel, in which the covariances are
# constrained to be equal
model <- '
X1 ~~ c(a1, a1)*X2 + c(a2, a2)*X3 + c(a3, a3)*X4
X2 ~~ c(a4, a4)*X3 + c(a5, a5)*X4
X3 ~~ c(a6, a6)*X4
X1 ~~ a7*X1
X2 ~~ a8*X2
X3 ~~ a9*X3
X4 ~~ a9*X4'

# fit the model with lavaan
fit1 <- sem(model = model, data = data, group = "group",
    meanstructure = FALSE)

modindices(fit1)
########################################################################################################
